ZKNOX_dilithium65.purpose: FIPS 204 ML-DSA-65 (k=6, l=5) on-chain verifier, ZKNoxHQ/ETHDILITHIUM branch mldsa-65. Deployed via plain CREATE (not the script's default CREATE2 -- the devnet has no deterministic-deployer-proxy singleton at 0x4e59b448..., unlike Base/Ethereum). The script's bundled on-chain self-check (writing a demo NIST KAT key via setKey, then verify) confirmed `NIST KAT verification: true` in local simulation before broadcast, but the broadcast of that follow-up setKey call itself failed on this devnet with a RPC-reported 'exceeds block gas limit' error -- NOT because the real cost is too high (a direct `cast estimate` of setKey with a correctly-sized ~40,320-byte expanded-key blob came back at 8,446,329 gas, under the devnet's 10,000,000 gas limit) but consistent with the already-documented cosmos/evm auto-gas-estimation bug in ADR-0007 (eth_fillTransaction simulates against genesis state, where a just-deployed contract doesn't exist yet). Real setKey/verify calls against this contract should pass an explicit --gas-limit rather than relying on auto-estimation, same guidance as ADR-0007 already gives for any EVM write against this chain.

interfaceNote: setKey's `pubkey` parameter is NOT the raw ~1952-byte FIPS 204 ML-DSA-65 public key -- it is the pre-expanded (A_hat || t1 || tr) blob, ~40,320 bytes, produced off-chain by ETHDILITHIUM's own js/mldsa65.js from the raw public key. contracts/pqc/IMlDsa65Verifier.sol in the account-abstraction fork's pqc-account branch now documents this correctly (fixed 2026-10-20).
warning: ZKNOX_dilithium65 is explicitly marked experimental and unaudited by its own authors ("DO NOT USE IN PRODUCTION, LOSS OF FUNDS WILL OCCUR", ZKNoxHQ/ETHDILITHIUM README, mldsa-65 branch, 2026-09-16 commit). This devnet deployment passed its own NIST KAT/ACVP test suite (22/22) when run locally before deployment, and the deployed bytecode itself passed a real on-chain NIST KAT check during the deploy script's local simulation. That is still not an independent audit. Devnet-only; do not point PqcAccountFactory's verifier at an equivalent deployment on Base or any chain carrying real value without a real audit first.
